title: Friedgut degree
statement: For a Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube and a real number $\varepsilon$, define its Friedgut degree to be the natural-number ceiling of the total influence of $f$, divided by $\varepsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
